mapper.select: SELECT idx, title, contents, url, isbn, `datetime`, authors, publisher, translators, price, sale_price, thumbnail FROM tb_books WHERE isbn <> ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_books (title, contents, url, isbn, `datetime`, authors, publisher, translators, price, sale_price, thumbnail) VALUES (#{title}, #{contents}, #{url}, #{isbn}, #{datetime}, #{authors}, #{publisher}, #{translators}, #{price}, #{salePrice}, #{thumbnail})
